preconditions: Performance Optimization must be merged first

tasks.title: Install MapLibre GL JS
tasks.description: Add maplibre-gl as a project dependency. Verify the package installs correctly and the TypeScript types are available.
acceptance_criteria: maplibre-gl added to package.json dependencies
Package installs without errors
TypeScript types available for maplibre-gl imports

tasks.title: Create TIGERweb API wrapper
tasks.description: Create src/lib/tigerweb.ts with typed functions: queryDistrictAtPoint(lng, lat) returns district info for a coordinate, and getAllDistrictsGeoJSON() returns a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of all 119th congressional districts. Include a FIPS-to-state-abbreviation mapping for translating TIGERweb FIPS codes to state abbreviations used in the legislators table.
acceptance_criteria: queryDistrictAtPoint(lng, lat) exported and returns DistrictInfo or null
getAllDistrictsGeoJSON() exported and returns GeoJSON FeatureCollection
DistrictInfo type includes state (FIPS), district number, name, and geoid
FIPS-to-state-abbreviation mapping covers all 50 states + DC
Functions construct correct TIGERweb URLs with proper query parameters

tasks.title: Write unit tests for TIGERweb wrapper
tasks.description: Add unit tests for the TIGERweb API wrapper. Mock fetch to test response parsing, error handling, and URL construction for both queryDistrictAtPoint and getAllDistrictsGeoJSON.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover successful point query with district result
Tests cover point query returning no results (ocean, outside US)
Tests cover TIGERweb error responses
Tests verify correct URL construction and query parameters
Tests cover FIPS-to-state mapping for known values
All tests pass with pnpm test

tasks.title: Create DistrictMap React component
tasks.description: Create src/components/DistrictMap.tsx as a client-only React component. Initialize MapLibre GL JS with a free base tile provider (Stadia Maps). Fetch district GeoJSON from TIGERweb on map load and add as a fill layer with semi-transparent styling and visible borders. Add click handler that calls queryDistrictAtPoint for the clicked coordinates.
acceptance_criteria: MapLibre GL JS initializes with Stadia Maps base tiles
District boundaries load from TIGERweb and display as fill layer
Districts have semi-transparent fill and visible border styling
Click on map triggers queryDistrictAtPoint with clicked coordinates
Map centers on continental US by default
Component handles loading state while GeoJSON fetches

tasks.title: Create DistrictTooltip component
tasks.description: Create src/components/DistrictTooltip.tsx that displays district info (state, district number, representative name and party) in a tooltip/popup on the map. Include a 'View Representative' link that navigates to the rep profile page. Query the local database to get rep name/party by state abbreviation and district number.
acceptance_criteria: Tooltip displays state name and district number
Tooltip shows representative name and party
Tooltip includes 'View Representative' link to /rep/[bioguideId]
Tooltip handles at-large districts (district '00')
Tooltip handles missing rep data gracefully

tasks.title: Add rep lookup API endpoint for map tooltips
tasks.description: Create an API endpoint that accepts state abbreviation and district number, returns the representative's bioguideId, name, and party. The DistrictTooltip component needs this to show rep info without a full page load. Use existing legislator query patterns.
acceptance_criteria: API endpoint accepts state and district parameters
Returns bioguideId, name, and party for the matching representative
Returns 404 for unknown state/district combinations
Handles at-large districts correctly
Uses Drizzle relational API for the query
Has export const prerender = false

tasks.title: Create map.astro page with lazy-loaded map
tasks.description: Create src/pages/map.astro as the dedicated map page. Use dynamic import to lazy-load the DistrictMap component (client-only, no SSR). Add preconnect hints for the tile server and TIGERweb. Include a loading skeleton that displays while the map component loads.
acceptance_criteria: Page available at /map route
DistrictMap loaded via dynamic import (client:only='react')
Preconnect hints for tiles.stadiamaps.com and tigerweb.geo.census.gov
Loading skeleton displays while map loads
Page has appropriate meta tags (title, description)
Tile provider attribution displayed on the map

tasks.title: Add map link to main navigation
tasks.description: Add a 'Map' link to the site's main navigation in the layout component, linking to /map.
acceptance_criteria: Map link appears in main navigation
Link navigates to /map
Active state shown when on /map page
Navigation order is logical (Map near other discovery features)

tasks.title: Add 'Find on map' link to ZIP lookup results
tasks.description: Add a link on the ZIP lookup results that directs users to the map page, providing a visual alternative to the text-based district information.
acceptance_criteria: Link to /map displayed on ZIP lookup results
Link text clearly indicates map-based district finding
Link does not appear if map page doesn't exist (defensive)

tasks.title: Handle TIGERweb errors gracefully
tasks.description: Add error handling for TIGERweb service failures in the DistrictMap component. Show a user-friendly error message suggesting ZIP code lookup as a fallback. Handle network errors, timeouts, and malformed responses.
acceptance_criteria: TIGERweb fetch failure shows user-friendly error message
Error message suggests ZIP code lookup as alternative
Network timeouts handled (not infinite loading)
Map remains interactive even if district overlay fails to load
Error state is visually distinct from loading state

tasks.title: Add E2E test for district map
tasks.description: Create tests/e2e/district-map.spec.ts that verifies the map page loads, the map renders, and navigation from the map to a rep page works. Test that the map link appears in navigation.
acceptance_criteria: E2E test navigates to /map and verifies page loads
Test verifies map canvas element renders
Test verifies map link exists in navigation
Test verifies loading skeleton appears then resolves
Test passes with pnpm test:e2e

tasks.title: Final verification and cleanup
tasks.description: Run full lint, typecheck, and test suite. Verify bundle size impact is under 250KB additional. Check all items from the verification checklist in docs/tasks/district-map.md. Verify map works on mobile with touch interactions.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm lint passes
pnpm typecheck passes
pnpm test passes (all unit tests)
pnpm test:e2e passes
Bundle size impact under 250KB additional gzipped
Map works on mobile with touch interactions
Map is keyboard navigable
All items in docs/tasks/district-map.md verification checklist pass
